name: enrich
description: In progress: Improve a draft prompt in place: ctrl+x e runs a quick pass that tidies it, ctrl+x d a deep pass that reads the conversation and restructures it. The same chord puts your original back.

quickModel.title: Quick-pass model
quickModel.description: The model the quick pass runs on: an alias (sonnet, haiku, opus) or a full model id.

quickEffort.title: Quick-pass effort
quickEffort.description: How hard the quick pass thinks. low keeps it to a few seconds.

deepFallbackModel.title: Deep-pass fallback model
deepFallbackModel.description: The deep pass reads the conversation through a fork of the session, on the session's own model. Before there is a conversation (a new session, or just after /clear) it runs on this model instead.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Give up on a pass after this long; your draft stays as it was.

houseStyle.title: House style
houseStyle.description: Add your standing preferences to both passes: ~/.claude/enrich.md (yours) and .claude/enrich.md in the project (wins where they conflict).

quickAction.title: Quick-pass action
quickAction.description: The engine keybinding action the quick-pass chord (ctrl+x e) is bound to. Plugins cannot register their own actions, so the chord borrows one whose only handler lives inside the diff dialog. Change it only if a Claude Code update breaks the default.

deepAction.title: Deep-pass action
deepAction.description: The engine keybinding action the deep-pass chord (ctrl+x d) is bound to; see Quick-pass action. It must differ from it.
